rationale: The original context from AMLAS v1.1 directly supports every element of the claim text: it defines a six-stage safety assurance methodology for ML components linking system safety requirements to data management, model learning, verification, and deployment; it explicitly states that its scope is limited to the ML component and should not be used in isolation from other standards/guidelines; and it specifies a primary focus on off-line supervised learning.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-004-R1 (PDF pp. 2–3, Introduction and Overview of AMLAS)
limitations: AMLAS v1.1 is public research guidance from the University of York, not an authority-issued means of compliance or formal regulatory approval.
